name: Nostalgia
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D); see text
Saving Throw Will negates (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill the target’s head with visions of good events and happy memories that leave them stuck in a bittersweet reverie. The target is dazed but may make a new save each round on their turn to break the effect.

This is a full round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
